newsitem.title: USA: PHILIPS TRIMS U.S. FLUKE STAKE.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS TRIMS U.S. FLUKE STAKE.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said Tuesday it cut its stake in Fluke Corp to 6.6 percent from about 7.8 percent.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Philips said it sold 102,500 Fluke shares between October 29 and November 7 at prices ranging from $38-$40 each.
The Netherlands-based electronics company said it still held its stake in Fluke, an Everett, Wash.,-based maker of industrial testing products, for investment purposes.
